notes: Merged from two passes that agree on the seven changed or created rows (ids, cells, values) and on six of seven dispositions. disagreement: Move all open cases: A kept, B repaired; kept (logged on the check). disagreement: the former primary's demotion: A a separate requirement, B folded into the deactivation's cells; kept A's split (logged in the requirement). disagreement: the stay on contact 4's six open cases is A only; kept as the boundary of the open-case selector (logged in the requirement). disagreement: notification sql: A without the anchor id, B with it; kept B's (logged in the requirement). disagreement: open-case selector: A with account_id = 4, B without; kept A's (logged in the requirement). disagreement: stay on contact 2's non-open cases: A by case ids, B by state selector; kept A's (logged in the requirement). disagreement: text of the contact 4 stay: A quotes the reassignment sentence, B the promotion sentence; kept B's because the boundary is of the most-recent-secondary selector in the promotion sentence. The 'most recent secondary contact' reading is by creation date (contact 3); by last update it would be contact 4. The notification's type = update is the benchmark's value, not fixed by the request or policy. The deactivation of the contact and of the portal user, and the demotion, have no original check. No tool writes case work notes, and the request asks for the handover detail in the case itself. Acting user 32 is an admin (active = 0 on the seed); the policy's default admin role is applied.
